help.user.title: JustWarp Commands
help.admin.title: Management Commands
help.user:
/jw: open the main menu
/jw warp: browse all warps
/jw group: browse all groups
/jw icon: browse custom icons
/jw back: return to the previous location
/jw help: show this help
help.admin:
/jw warp add <name> <icon> [group]: add a warp
/jw warp del <name>: delete a warp
/jw warp set <name> position: update a warp position
/jw warp set <name> <name|group|icon|author|description> <value>: update a warp field
/jw group add <name> <icon>: add a group
/jw group del <name>: delete a group
/jw group set <name> <name|icon> <value>: update a group field
/jw icon add <name> <base64>: add a custom icon
/jw icon del <name>: delete a custom icon
/jw icon set <name> <new_base64>: update a custom icon
/jw reload: reload configuration and data
Quote Unicode, spaced, and special-character text values; tab completion adds quotes automatically.
